UI_BetterContainers_Options_allowReorder: When enabled will allow the reordering of inventory container buttons, including player buttons
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showAdvanced: When enabled will improve the display categories of items in the inventory panels (Small lag when enabling)
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit: Show Pinned Item Types on Player Inventory
When enabled, pinned item types are also shown on the player inventory.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped: When enabled, worn, held, and attached hotbar items are grouped into one collapsible section in the player inventory.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_categoryBlac: Better Containers will not recategorize items already using these script DisplayCategory names. Separate categories with commas. Enter none to disable.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableCustom: When enabled will allow the customizing of inventory container buttons
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested: When enabled, containers inside the player inventory are shown as additional container buttons.
When enabled, containers inside loot inventories are shown as additional container buttons.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo: When enabled, nested container buttons show the icon of the container they are inside.
UI_BetterContainers_SortValue_tooltip: Enter a number to sort by.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableProxim: Keybind used to toggle Proximity Inventory feature
UI_BetterContainers_Options_forceProximi: Keybind used to force lock Proximity Inventory
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableCorpse: Enables/Disables Proximity Inventory in Corpse Only mode
UI_BetterContainers_Options_corpseOnlyMo: Keybind used to force Corpse Only mode
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo: CAUTION: Auto-Locking Functionality - Overrides Default Behaviour

When enabled lock keybind is ignored and locking is automatic. Players can browse inventories and when moving away or after 10 ingame minutes the selected inventory snaps back to Proximity/Corpse inventory.
